story.sectionDesc: Two hearts, two families, one beautiful beginning — and a new chapter waiting to unfold.

card1.title: The First Impression
card1.front: I played it incredibly cool but was nervous a lot. She was captivated by my charm in silence.
card1.back: He was so nervous he couldn't stop talking. But I thought it was kind of cute.

card2.title: The First Date
card2.front: I arrived early and was too nervous to even make eye contact. I was just happy she agreed to meet me.
card2.back: I spent hours getting ready so I would look perfect, and I was so happy he was there.

card3.title: The Big Decision
card3.front: I knew she was the one but I was too afraid to admit it.
card3.back: I dropped 100 obvious hints until he finally realized it was time.

card4.title: The Future
card4.front: I can't wait to spend the rest of my life agreeing with her.
card4.back: I can't wait to spend the rest of my life always being right.
